name: Cancel Picker
purpose: Cancels the picker: puts {Result.Canceled: true} into Picker::Results, disables triggers while the window closes, and closes the window.

name: Go to Picker Button
purpose: Moves focus to the picker button object; run manually or OnRecordLoad.

name: Close Picker
purpose: Closes the picker window and returns True.

name: Snippet
purpose: Script template (snippet) with a purpose header and a section variable. Effect owner would be client-ui; no effect.

name: Go to Search Field
purpose: Moves focus to the search field object; run through a custom menu.

name: Use Test Data
purpose: Developer test hook: opens karbon_data hidden from a path given in the parameter and runs OnFirstWindowOpen. Effect owner would be client-ui.
